game.name: Incredible Hulk, The (USA)(En,Fr)
game.desc: Bruce Banner lands with a bang on Xbox 360 and he's not happy. So he turns into the Hulk. The Incredible Hulk features the green giant with the rip-stop pants and offers a storyline that follows the feature film of the same name while offering new passages, all in a mostly destructible environment for a 100% brutal action game guaranteed with GMOs.
